Implemented the Rust migration as a complete Cargo package in `/output`. The entry binary is [test7.rs](/output/test7.rs:1), with the inferred library behavior split into [progress_display.rs](/output/indicators/progress_display.rs:1) and [percentage.rs](/output/indicators/percentage.rs:1), and the package manifest at [Cargo.toml](/output/Cargo.toml:1).

The binary matches the C++ program’s single optional positional argument, default value, `std::stoi`-style prefix parsing, progress formatting, percentage formatting, and Linux abort behavior for invalid and out-of-range input. It built successfully with both `cargo build --release` and `rustc --edition 2021 test7.rs -o test7`. Executables are at `/output/target/release/test7` and `/output/test7`, and I verified byte-for-byte parity against `/workspace/dataset/test7_executable` on normal and edge-case inputs.
